page_title: STR 2-1 TOU | Strasbourg v Toulouse 16/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Eduard Sobol (Strasbourg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90+3' Joshua King (Toulouse) serves up a nice cross, but Djordje Petrovic punches the ball away.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
88' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Emanuel Emegha walks off the pitch to be replaced by Sekou Mara (Strasbourg).
87' Substitution. Sebastian Nanasi is replaced by Daouda Diongue (Strasbourg).
85' Florent Batta interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg).
85' A pass finds the feet of Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
85' Here is a change. Cristian Casseres is going off and Carles Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Miha Zajc (Toulouse).
84' The Toulouse players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
83' Felix Lemarechal will be replaced by Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg).
79' Liam Rosenior has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Eduard Sobol (Strasbourg) replacing Samuel Amo-Ameyaw.
78' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) gets to the ball in the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He didn't hit the ball properly and skies it high over the crossbar.
77' Strasbourg work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
77' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Diego Moreira (Strasbourg). Strasbourg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Shavy Babicka departs the field of play to be replaced by Noah Edjouma (Toulouse).
76' Carles Martinez has decided to make a change. Joshua King (Toulouse) replaces Djibril Sidibe.
74' Toulouse can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
70' Neat passing move from Strasbourg in order to create new attacking opportunities.
69' Djordje Petrovic (Strasbourg) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
67' Djordje Petrovic (Strasbourg) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
66' Substitution. Rafik Messali (Toulouse) in, Yann Gboho out.
64' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
64' The current number of shots on goal is 3:6.

63' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Kjetil Haug anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
62' Strasbourg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

54' 2 - 1 2:1. Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) latches on to a pass on the edge of the penalty area and immediately fires a fantastic first-time shot into the top left corner of the net. What a finish that is! Kjetil Haug did his best to stop it, but the shot was just too good. Samuel Amo-Ameyaw provided the assistance.
52' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just over the crossbar.
51' Djordje Petrovic pulls off a great save to deny Yann Gboho (Toulouse) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
48' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
47' 1 - 1 Goal! Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) makes the score 1:1 after burying a close-range header in the right side of the goal after a good run and cross by Diego Moreira.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Kjetil Haug, who smothers the ball.
44' Strasbourg take a short corner kick.
37' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

37' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick.
35' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
32' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) passes the ball and slows down the tempo so his team can continue with their combination play.
31' Strasbourg are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
28' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
25' Toulouse seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
24' Frank Magri (Toulouse) has tested the patience of referee Florent Batta and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
24' Strasbourg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
24' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
23' The corner is swung in but Toulouse can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
20' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Strasbourg comes to nothing.

19' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Strasbourg will have a chance to score from a corner.
17' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
17' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
9' Great teamplay by Strasbourg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
6' Florent Batta couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) and blew his whistle.
4' 0 - 1 Goal! Frank Magri (Toulouse) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
2' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the right post to safety.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Toulouse will have the kick-off.
Florent Batta will officiate today.
